name: بطولة حجر ورقة مقص
tagline: بطولة إقصائية من حجر ورقة مقص: الأفضل من ثلاث، والأخير يفوز.
description: العب بطولة حجر ورقة مقص مجانًا: جدول لـ 2 إلى 16 لاعبًا، الأفضل من ثلاث، والرميات مخفية حتى يرمي الاثنان. ضد روبوتات أو على جهاز واحد أو عبر الإنترنت.
about: Rock Paper Scissors Tournament is the hand game everybody knows, played as a knockout bracket for 2 to 16 players, with friends, bots, or online. Rock blunts scissors, scissors cut paper, and paper wraps rock.

Each match is best of three (or five): both players throw at once, in secret, and the same throw is thrown again. Win the match and you meet another winner in the next round; the last one standing is champion. With an odd number of players, some start with a bye.
It looks like pure luck, but people fall into patterns: a favourite throw, or the same move after a win. Online, each throw is held on our server until both are in, so nobody can wait to see yours.
howToPlay: Choose best of three or five, then Play vs bots, Play on this device, or create a room.
When your match is on, tap Rock, Paper or Scissors.
Your throw stays hidden until your opponent throws; then both are shown and the score changes.
The same throw is thrown again. First to two wins (three, in best of five) goes through.
Follow the bracket below: the last one standing is champion.
controls: Phones and tablets: tap a throw.
Keyboard: Tab to a throw; Enter or Space throws it.
tips: Mix it up: any pattern you fall into can be read.
Many players repeat a throw that just won, and switch after a loss.
Watch the other matches: everyone's throws are shown in the bracket's history.
Against bots, easy ones throw at random; hard ones look for your habits.

faq.question: Is it free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: Can my opponent see my throw first?
faq.answer: No. Online, each throw is held on our server until both players have thrown, then both are shown at once.

faq.question: What happens on a tie?
faq.answer: The same throw is thrown again, and doesn't count. A match still level after 15 throws goes to whoever has won more, then to the one drawn first.

faq.question: How many can play?
faq.answer: From 2 to 16. With a number that isn't 2, 4, 8 or 16, the first players drawn get a bye into the second round.
